title: `ObjectForm` edit mode still sends every sanitized field: objectui#10108's 「only dirty」 half is delivered for master-detail child rows only, not for the parent op or the plain record `PATCH`
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (Seat: domain:ui#2, session `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`) while accepting PR objectui#10154 for objectui#10108. ⛔ Filed bare: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are the triage seat's production.

## Why this exists — objectui#10108's stated expectation is only PARTLY met, and that is recorded here rather than glossed

objectui#10108's Expected section, and the triage boundary written under it, asked for two things:

> **正确**:只发**脏**字段,且任何情况下不发服务端管理/注入字段(`owner_id`、`owning_business_unit_id`、`organization_id`、`created_*`、`updated_*`)。

PR objectui#10154 fully delivers the second half — on both paths, with a class fix (the spec `system` flag) so the next injected column needs no edit — and delivers the **first half only for master-detail CHILD rows**. The master-detail **parent** operation and the **plain record edit `PATCH`** still send the full sanitized form values.

⇒ the 403 this family produced is shut, and shut durably. What is not done is 「only dirty」 on two of the three payloads.

## Why it was left, and why the seat agreed

Not an oversight — a structural boundary the accepting seat judged real. The child rows have a loaded snapshot to diff against; the parent's persisted record is fetched **inside** `ObjectForm` and never handed back out, so a parent dirty diff needs a new seam through the form's `submitHandler` contract.

⚠️ And the risk is asymmetric in the dangerous direction. This is the most-used write path in the product; a false CLEAN silently drops a user's edit and returns **200**. PR objectui#10154's child-row comparison resolves everything it cannot settle **towards sending** for exactly that reason. Extending the diff to the parent and the plain form deserves its own card, its own pins and its own reverse verification — ⛔ not a rider on a card whose defect was the roster.

## The work, if this is graded in

Give `ObjectForm`'s edit mode a way to compare against the record it loaded, and send only fields that differ — which covers the master-detail parent operation and the plain `PATCH` at once.

⚠️ Read PR objectui#10154's landed diff first, in particular `sanitizeFormData`'s resolve-towards-sending rule for an unsettleable comparison. Any new comparison must take the same direction: ⛔ a field whose cleanliness cannot be established is SENT, never dropped.

## Dedupe words

`ObjectForm edit mode dirty diff` · `plain record PATCH sends full form values` · `master-detail parent operation not dirty-diffed` · `objectui#10108 only-dirty half` · `submitHandler seam loaded record snapshot`
